summary: Defined the board transition contract for safe UI actions. The contract maps board lane intents to exact CLI commands, requires confirmation for every mutating command, forbids raw runtime state writes, preserves evidence-before-verification policy, and documents activeBlockerIds as a derived unresolved-blocker subset. Added a regression docs test for the safety clauses.
command: pnpm test -- tests/runtime/workflow-docs.test.ts; pnpm check; pnpm test; git diff --check
